name: Speaker Display — Direct Axis Sensor Air Quality
description: Every 60 seconds, pull air quality data (CO₂, temperature, humidity) directly from a remote Axis environmental sensor using vapix_query and display it on the speaker-display screen. No MQTT broker or middleware needed — the display polls the sensor itself.
